## How it was tested
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] `python -m buildbix.ci.check` passes (if CI templates changed)

## Checklist
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or keys included
- [ ] Docs updated (README / docs/) if behaviour changed
- [ ] Security-sensitive input (uploads, AI output, webhooks) is validated
